messages:
Devon (Growth): Heads-up finance/billing  we launched the WEEKLY40 pricing experiment and ops flagged an unexpected rollout. Looks like WEEKLY40 was applied as a recurring account-level coupon to ~48 customers for the whole month instead of only the experiment bucket. Customers are starting to ping support.

billing-bot: Pricing experiment WEEKLY40 toggled 2026-10-12 02:11 UTC. Promo details: -40% reserved base for experiment bucket (intended: first invoice only). Affected provisional invoices generated between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-18 show promo applied as recurring.

Hannah (BillingOps): Confirmed. I pulled the batch: 48 accounts got recurring coupon tags. Sample: ACCT-881 ($1,200 reserved) got -480 on three invoices; ACCT-902 ($600 reserved) got -240 twice. Preliminary liability across accounts ~ $28,740. I'm preparing a full export.

Olive (Finance): Oof. Two paths: (A) If customers received an over-credit (we gave too much discount) we need to correct by applying invoices/credit reversal. (B) If customers were under-credited (promo meant to be one-off but system applied recurring) we must issue credit. We need a reconciliation: which accounts were net over-credited vs under-credited. Devon, can you confirm expected experiment scope and intended promo timing from Growth?

Devon (Growth): Intended scope = 100 test users, promo applied to first invoice only. Toggle was mis-scoped in the admin UI and written as "recurring". We own this. Growth recommends full corrective credits for any customer who lost value. Also propose a $50 goodwill on impacted accounts where error caused invoice confusion.

Hannah (BillingOps): Reconciliation run: out of 48 accounts, 31 were over-credited (we gave them recurring discount when they should not have received further discounts) => we need to reverse those extra credits; 17 were under-credited due to proration mismatch (we applied recurring but the first invoice wasn't fully discounted) => we owe those credits. Net company liability (credits we must give) = $6,920. Breakdown example: 
- ACCT-881: Over-credit net +$720 (we gave $720 more than intended) -> reversal needed 720.00
- ACCT-902: Under-credit -$180 (we owe them) -> credit 180.00
- ACCT-918: Over-credit +$1,200 -> reversal 1,200.00
(full csv attached in support ticket PR-EXP-2245).

Olive (Finance): Given net liability < $10k, I can approve corrective credits up to $10k and discretionary $1k for goodwill offers. For reversals (refunds we need to pull back), check payment status: if refunded already, we should create offsetting chargebacks; if not, apply credit memos or invoice replacements. Hannah, prepare credit memos for owed credits and reversal instructions for over-credits. Devon, please coordinate a short customer note and offer goodwill where helpful.

Hannah (BillingOps): Preparing memos. I'll create two sets: REVERSAL memos for over-credited accounts (ledger entries REF-CR-2245-*) and CREDIT memos for owed credits (CR-2245-*). Example entry for ACCT-902: 
```
CreditMemo: CR-2245-002
Customer: ACCT-902
Amount: -180.00 USD
AppliedTo: INV-2026-10-13-902
Reason: Corrective credit due to experiment misconfiguration (PR-EXP-2245)
CreatedBy: Hannah (BillingOps)
```
Example reversal entry for ACCT-881: 
```
Reversal: REF-CR-2245-031
Customer: ACCT-881
Amount: +720.00 USD
AppliedTo: Invoice adjustments; follow payment status; contact payments-team
Reason: Reversal of recurring experiment discount applied in error
CreatedBy: Hannah (BillingOps)
```
I'll tag payments-team for chargeback routing on any already-paid refunds.

Devon (Growth): We'll absorb any goodwill credits. Growth can cover up to $1k in promo recoverability costs this month for customer satisfaction. Also launching a post-mortem: PR-EXP-2245 and will schedule patch to admin UI immediately.

ops-eng: ENG ticket created: ENG-billing-1302. Root cause: admin toggle allowed "recurring" by default; rollout script lacked scope guard. Patch ETA 24 hours.

billing-bot: Batch creation summary: 31 reversal actions and 17 credit memos queued. Total reversal nominal amount = 21,820.00; credits amount = 28,740.00; net company credit exposure = 6,920.00.

Olive (Finance): Proceed. Hannah, apply the credit memos CR-2245-001..CR-2245-017 for the owed credits. For reversals, open chargeback requests for any already-paid refunds and if not yet refunded, apply offsetting invoices. Document all ledger notes as "Experiment misconfig PR-EXP-2245 - Growth-owned". Provide me the batch journal when done.

Hannah (BillingOps): Will do. Starting batch apply now. Will post when complete. :gear:

billing-bot: All credit memos CR-2245-001..CR-2245-017 created and applied 2026-10-18 16:12 UTC. Reversal requests REF-CR-2245-001..REF-CR-2245-031 queued for payments-team. Net exposure recorded as 6,920.00 and charged to Growth cost center.

Devon (Growth): Thank you everyone  we'll send the customer communication and log a follow-up with PMs. Apologies for the confusion.

Olive (Finance): Please attach the CSV to the finance folder and mark the batch closed. Also include a short entry for auditors: "WEEKLY40 experiment misconfiguration corrected; net credit exposure $6,920; covered by Growth; memos CR-2245-001..CR-2245-017; reversals REF-CR-2245-001..REF-CR-2245-031; ticket PR-EXP-2245; ENG-billing-1302."

Hannah (BillingOps): Done. Ledger notes added and audit CSV uploaded to finance share (FIN/experiments/PR-EXP-2245.csv). Closing thread.
